info.description:
REST API for creating single-currency wallets and performing deposits,
withdrawals, transfers, and transaction-history queries.

Financial mutations are atomic and idempotent. Amounts are decimal strings,
never JSON numbers. `X-User-ID` represents a trusted upstream principal in
this assignment; a public deployment must derive it from verified credentials.

Only successfully committed financial operations appear in history. Rejected
requests do not create financial transactions or ledger entries.
info.title: Wallet Service API

destination wallet. Both wallets must use the request currency. Wallets
are locked in stable UUID order to avoid opposing-transfer deadlocks.
